data.name: Charul
data.gender_notes: Charul is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Charu' which means 'that which is beautiful, lovely or precious'. This name is often given to girls born under the moon's influence, symbolizing the gentle, nurturing and joyful nature of the moon. The name Charul carries the meaning “Beautiful, lovely, precious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Charul usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful, lovely, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner beauty and grace of an individual, inspiring them to radiate positivity and joy in their surroundings.
data.etymology: Charul belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful, lovely, precious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charul total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
